text: A module M is flat if and only if:
choices: Tor₁^R(M, N) = 0 for every module N
Ext¹_R(M, N) = 0 for every module N
M ⊗_R N = 0 for every module N
Tor₀^R(M, N) = 0 for every module N
explanation: Vanishing of Tor₁ against everything already forces all higher Tor to vanish, so − ⊗ M is exact. The Ext¹ condition instead characterizes projective modules; projective ⇒ flat but not conversely (ℚ over ℤ is flat, not projective).
